digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter — user identity contract
propositions: Cloud and Data Center identify users differently (accountId vs name), causing divergent assignee resolution and payload shapes to leak into the adapter layer
PR #120 made DC assignee resolution permanently non-authoritative by consulting an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, causing the diff to re-emit unconverged assignee changes (the ace2 churn class)

A UserIdentityModel Protocol with two implementations (AccountIdIdentity for Cloud, NameIdentity for DC) must encapsulate the identity contract, with resolver passed as an explicit constructor parameter rather than discovered via getattr
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable diff convergence, whereas AccountIdIdentity preserves Cloud's existing behavior

Tests must verify the 3-state resolution contract (same/different/unassigned) identically for both models, and specifically assert DC returns authoritative=True for resolvable assignees to prevent churn regression
